title: What you're looking at
copy: This is a map of my engineering work. In the Time view, position shows when a project happened; color identifies the employer. Open a project to follow its constraints, decisions, and supporting evidence.

title: How I built this
copy: I built this record from project archives, design decisions, test reports, and shipped outcomes. Claims are checked against source material before they become public copy.

title: The tools behind it
copy: I keep the source record separately from the site. Reviewed material becomes public pages through repeatable builds and checks, so the presentation can change without losing the underlying evidence.

title: Where to go next
copy: Start with the Tour for a short path through the work, open a project for the full record, or read How I Work for the method behind the interventions.
